title: Two Sum
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer target, return the indices of two distinct elements whose values add to target. You may return the two indices in either order.
constraints: Exactly one valid pair exists for every input used by this problem.

examples.explanation: The two equal values are separate array elements.

python.display_signature: def twoSum(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]
